The '''New Republic Fleet Office''' was a department of the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic]]. The [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]], the [[New Republic Marine]]s, and the [[New Republic Fleet Intelligence]] all belonged to the Fleet Office.
